revisions.name: $run
revisions.reason: run() calls $dmusic_service once per slice next to $anim_service. It returns at once unless a DirectMusic performance has been initialized, then sends due MIDI channel messages of playing segments through the existing host midiOut short-message import (no callback, the device is opened with CALLBACK_NULL). It reads only performance/segment records in the guest heap, never writes EIP, registers or the guest stack, retains no pointer past the call and adds no callback, exception boundary or target.
